name: Grand Hyatt Macau
positioning: Two-tower Grand Hyatt within City of Dreams in Cotai, Macau, with a large spa, a year-round outdoor pool and Cotai or fountain views
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside the City of Dreams complex in Cotai
Couples looking for a spa with couples treatment suites and outdoor hot tubs
Families who want a year-round outdoor pool with lifeguards

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Macau is located within City of Dreams in the Cotai area of Macau.
Guest rooms and suites are in the hotel's Grand Tower or Grand Club Tower, with views over Cotai.
Fountain View rooms and suites offer views of the fountain.
The Premier Suite has a work space, a spacious living room and a full kitchen.
Isala Spa has outdoor hot tubs, steam rooms and freeze showers.
Lifeguards are on duty at the outdoor pool during service hours, making it a good venue for families.
Beijing Kitchen serves Northern Chinese cuisine, including slow-roasted duck.
Fountain Cafe offers daily baked pastries, light meals and an afternoon tea service.
The hotel is near the MLRT Cotai East Station, exit A.
The hotel provides limousine service, with a choice of a Maybach, a Mercedes-Benz S500 or a multipurpose vehicle.
The pillarless Grand Ballroom hosts weddings for up to 2,000 guests.

highlights.text: Isala Spa spreads over approximately 25,000 square feet and includes treatment rooms and suites designed for couples.
Isala Spa has a dedicated foot massage room overlooking private landscaped gardens.
Grand Club privileges include breakfast and evening cocktails at the Grand Club Lounge on the 37th floor of the Grand Club Tower.
The hotel has a temperature-controlled outdoor pool that is open year-round.
The Presidential Suite is on level 33 and features a study room, kitchen, dining area, spa and a private gym.

considerations.text: Senado Square, Macau's urban centre, is about 3.6 miles from the hotel.
The hotel is about a 15-minute drive from Macau International Airport.
